newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close sharply lower on politics.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close sharply lower on politics.

text.p: French shares closed down sharply on Friday on political uncertainty stirred by growing speculation of an early parliamentary election, brokers said.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index ended 67.62 points or 2.59 percent lower at 2,547.56. It had reached a low of 2,540.79 during the day.
The CAC-40 futures contract for April was down 14 points at 2,547. Total volume was a hefty eight billion francs.
"Prospects of an early election drove the market down," one broker said.
Most blue chips were hit by the market fall as both French and domestic investors hedged positions.
* AGF ended down 2.46 percent to 194.5 francs. The French insurer declined to comment on a French newspaper report it planned to tap markets for four billion francs because interest rates were low.
* PSA Peugeot Citroen lost 4.09 percent to 586 francs. Several brokers cut their earnings estimates for the group in 1997 and 1998 following disappointing 1996 results.
* Rival carmaker Renault closed down 5.66 percent to 130 francs.
